description: This file defines the abstract class ExtensionList in the Drupal core, which manages and provides information about extensions (modules, themes, profiles, etc.) including caching, discovery, and info parsing.

classes.name: ExtensionList
classes.description: An abstract class in Drupal core that manages the discovery, caching, and retrieval of extensions such as modules, themes, and profiles.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ExtensionList with root path, type, cache, info parser, module handler, state, and install profile.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets cached extension data and clears related cache and state entries.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns all available extensions, utilizing cache if possible.

methods.name: doScanExtensions
methods.description: Scans the filesystem for extensions of the specified type.

methods.name: doList
methods.description: Builds the list of extensions by scanning and parsing info files.

methods.name: getExtensionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info array for a specific extension by name.

methods.name: getAllAvailableInfo
methods.description: Returns info arrays for all available extensions, with caching.

methods.name: getInstalledExtensionNames
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to list installed extension names.

methods.name: getAllInstalledInfo
methods.description: Returns info for installed extensions only.

methods.name: recalculateInfo
methods.description: Generates extension info arrays from the list of extensions.

methods.name: getPathNames
methods.description: Returns list of extension file paths, cached in state.

methods.name: recalculatePathNames
methods.description: Generates sorted list of extension info file locations.

methods.name: setPathname
methods.description: Manually sets the path for an extension, used during bootstrap.

methods.name: getPathname
methods.description: Retrieves the path to an extension's info file, with fallback to static cache.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the directory path of an extension.

methods.name: createExtensionInfo
methods.description: Creates the info array for an extension, parsing its info file and adding metadata.

methods.name: checkIncompatibility
methods.description: Checks if an extension is incompatible based on core version or PHP requirements.

methods.name: sortByName
methods.description: Static method to compare two extensions by their name for sorting.
